title: Length of flattened equal-length groups
statement: Let $k,n$ be natural numbers and let $G$ be a finite list of lists of actions for $k$ Boolean work tapes and successor states in $\mathrm{Fin}(n+1)$. If every list in $G$ has length $3^{k+1}$, then the concatenation of all lists in $G$ has length $|G|\,3^{k+1}$.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a finite list of lists of the specified actions
Every list belonging to $G$ has length $3^{k+1}$
